_note: Compact form of the SS-W9 three-layer cells. One row per county per rail. Prose that repeats identically across thousands of cells is factored into `gapBasisLegend` rather than repeated; nothing else is dropped. The full-prose form is regenerable with packages/retrieval/scripts/three-layer-audit.mjs.

gapBasisLegend.layer-not-measured: written and scored; the served sweep has not reached this county, so its served state is unknown. An absent measurement is not a zero.
gapBasisLegend.store-empty: zero atoms of this family carry this county's prefix. Remediation is acquisition plus ingestion, the most expensive of the three.
gapBasisLegend.ledger-stale: 3791 atoms are written and the ledger cell reads not-yet. Remediation is a scorer run.
gapBasisLegend.scorer-absent: 7682 atoms are written and county_facet_coverage holds NO row for this facet at all, so the cell reads not-yet by precedence and RECOMPUTING THE LEDGER WOULD NOT MOVE IT. Remediation is building or running a scorer for this facet, not a refresh.
gapBasisLegend.ceiling-reached: the rail holds atoms in 15 counties against its own reachable ceiling of 15 of 254; an empty county here is not a hole this rail's source could fill.
gapBasisLegend.no-served-slot: written and scored, but the parcel fact sheet carries no field for this rail, so no merge could surface it. Remediation is adding a served field, which is larger than a merge fix and must not be priced as one.
